source: TCGdex API v2 (en), limited to the 205 sets in public/data/catalog/en-sets.json
definition: A card has no image when TCGdex returns no `image` field for it (the app's search/binder grid then shows no picture: src/data/catalog/tcgdex.ts uses item.image). The card detail view additionally tries an inferred assets.tcgdex.net URL; inferredImageHighWebpStatus shows whether that fallback actually exists (200) or not.
